work_summary: Root-caused the recurring self-inflicted build breakage: commit authors are LLM agents running in terminal sessions, woken by scripts/runtime/terminal-heartbeat-pulse.cjs injections, editing and committing the shared live checkout. Commits bf04b72a2 (zeroed cli.ts), e2271e7c3/dce732ccc (half-landed authority-service rewrite) all share this origin; no --no-verify bypass exists — the gates passed because they were vacuous for those failure shapes.

Shipped scripts/security/zero-file-guard.cjs: blocks any staged commit that reduces a previously-substantial tracked file (>1KiB at HEAD) to 0 bytes. Wired into .husky/pre-commit after secret:sweep:staged and exposed as pnpm zero-file:guard:staged. Escape hatch: TNF_ALLOW_EMPTY_COMMIT_FILE=1 with loud logging, matching house gate style.
Verified both directions with a synthetic index: truncating cli.ts is BLOCKED (exit 1), the real clean index passes (exit 0).

Identified remaining hole for policy-level treatment (not code): heartbeat-injected sessions need a stronger instruction that shared-checkout fleet work belongs on task branches, and 'chore: routine updates' sweeps must not include source files.
Also carries the prettier normalization residue left by the lint-staged pass of the lazy-registration commit (cli.ts, whatsapp/index.ts) so worktree and HEAD agree.

verification.notes: Guard verified on synthetic index: truncation blocked (exit 1), clean index passes (exit 0). tnf-cli type-check clean. No agent bypass of husky found in scripts/; the vacuous-gate hole is what this closes.

resume_checklist: Add the policy-side instruction for heartbeat-driven agents: no source files in automated sweep commits; work on branches.
Keep com.tnf.subdirector-autopilot unloaded until its writer is audited.
